title:
Color stereo 3D cameras
for collaborative robots
lede_b: g eye-in-hand camera: point cloud and registered color image in one capture.
stat1_desc_a: Mounted on the flange of collaborative robots; two models,
stat2_desc: A point cloud and a registered color image from every capture.
body: The registered color image lets TridiVision segment mixed parcels, packaged goods, tools and fasteners by color and printed markings as well as by shape; the point cloud gives the pick pose.
th_fov: Field of view at optimum WD (mm)
footnote: <sup>1</sup> Regional 2σ on a ceramic reference plate, method on page 22. Full specification on pages 18 to 20.
app1: Colored blocks and balls in a tote — sorting by color and shape — color image
app2: Hand tools in a bin — recognition and picking — color image
app3: Hand tools — the same capture — height map
app4: Mixed items in a tote — piece picking — color image
app5: Screws, nuts and washers — mixed fastener picking — color image
app6: Packaged goods — picking by print and shape — color image
